scenario: Laterality flip on temporal sequelae and on their hemorrhage rule-out + SPU on sphenoid + clean matches
description: Real subset of head-ct/findings_{gt,pred}/example_1. Demonstrates a laterality flip on lateralized brain pathology (gt 'left temporal pole' hypodense sequelae vs pred 'right temporal pole' — opposite hemisphere, matched and scored downstream as a major side error from the findings' laterality), a hallucinated mucosal thickening of the sphenoid sinus in the prediction (SPU), and a clean 1:1 match on the left temporal horn ventricular traction. The hemorrhage rule-out inside the sequelae ('without spontaneous hyperdensity') is its own finding, as Stage 1 extracts it; the two rule-outs, placed on opposite sides like the sequelae, match each other.

user.indication: Head trauma with left frontotemporal hemorrhagic contusion, thin left temporal subdural hematoma.

No spontaneous hyperdensity in the right temporal sequelae.
